page.overview:
What is Motorbreath?

Motorbreath is the third track from Metallica's debut album Kill 'Em All.

It is about "life in the fast lane". James Hetfield wrote this song with his high school friend Hugh Tanner before Metallica was even formed, and it is one of only two songs that Lars Ulrich doesn't receive writing credits for.

Living and dying, laughing and crying Once you have seen it you'll never be the same Life in the fast lane is just how it seems Hard and it's heavy and dirty and mean

Motorbreath It's how I live my life I can't take it any other way Motorbreath The sign of living fast It is going to take your breath away
